name: IT interrupt-while
description: A while of three passes, each of which adds a line to a file in the scratch directory; the second pass ever waits for a file of the test. For an interrupt inside the loop: the file says how often the body ran.

config.command: echo pass >> "{{ scratch_dir }}/passes.txt"; n=$(wc -l < "{{ scratch_dir }}/passes.txt"); if [ $n -eq 2 ]; then w=0; while [ ! -e "{{ project_path }}/go" ] && [ $w -lt 900 ]; do sleep 0.1; w=$((w + 1)); done; test -e "{{ project_path }}/go" || exit 9; fi; echo pass $n
